proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring end-of-page zone (rc2) with a CTA heading and a pipe-only link row, identical at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from per-page block inventory; model as a global footer fragment/site-wide chrome, analogous to the confirmed knack-announcement-bar rule.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure across every page examined in this batch.

proposed_rules.trigger: A gradient-background zone directly under the hero containing a single stat/savings heading (e.g. '$250,000+') plus a quoted customer testimonial.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as one 'testimonial' block (stat + quote cells) inside a gradient-styled section. Rejected alternative: splitting the stat and quote into two separate default-content items, since they form one authored customer-proof component reused elsewhere on the site.
proposed_rules.rationale: Distinct from the trust-badge-strip pattern (single testimonial vs. a row of N badges); already covered structurally by the confirmed background-container and heading-then-component rules, but the block name/shape itself is not yet codified.
